task: NUAA step zero: descriptive image statistics of the authorised NUAA materials, set against the per-image scores already delivered (C1, N1, N2)
nature: descriptive: no training, no inference, no face detection, no new threshold; the measures show associations between image statistics, class, session and delivered scores, not causes
authorisation: coordinator's comment on the C2 card, 2026-11-03: the step zero may proceed on the NUAA materials already authorised

declarations.unit: image frame; frames of one subject and session are correlated

decision_rule: attack if score_attack > threshold (tie = bona fide)

statistics.lum_mean: mean of the OpenCV grey image (0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B, uint8), 0-255
statistics.lum_std: population standard deviation of the grey image, 0-255
statistics.sat_mean: mean of the S channel of the OpenCV HSV conversion, 0-255
statistics.lap_var: population variance of the 3x3 Laplacian of the grey image (cv2.Laplacian, CV_64F, ksize 1)
statistics.width: image width in pixels (raw view only)
statistics.height: image height in pixels (raw view only)
statistics.bytes: size of the original file in bytes, from the manifest (raw view only)

views.raw: the original file read with cv2.imread (BGR), every image of the two official lists
views.crop: the 6,000 frames of the training cache nuaa_1500.npz (RGB uint8 256x256: detector crop of the original, resize, then the reference enhancement chain: bilateral filter, CLAHE, unsharp mask, gamma and a final linear contrast/brightness step): cnn_train, cnn_es, cnn_test. The crop view describes the network input after the reference enhancement chain, not the face region of the original

measures.quartiles: median, first and third quartile (linear interpolation) per set, session and class
measures.class_auroc: AUROC of the statistic as a class separator: label 1 = attack, higher statistic -> attack; Mann-Whitney U with ties counted 0.5; a value below 0.5 means bona fide frames have the higher statistic
measures.class_auroc_ci: percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 of the class AUROC over 1,000 resamples with replacement of the subjects of the session (seed 0, the same resamples for every statistic); a resample without one of the classes does not count (valid_resamples)
measures.within_subject_auroc: class AUROC computed inside each subject x session with both classes; median, minimum and maximum over those subjects, with their number (per-subject values in the restricted per_subject_auroc.csv)
measures.all_row: in the all row of a set with two sessions the sessions of a subject are pooled, for the within-subject AUROC and for the bootstrap alike
measures.spearman: Spearman rank correlation (average ranks for ties) between the statistic and score_attack; NA with fewer than 3 pairs or a constant variable
measures.rejected_vs_accepted: bona fide frames of session 03: AUROC of the statistic between the frames rejected (prediction 1) and accepted at 0.5; rejected = positive
measures.crop_view: the crop view describes the network input after the reference enhancement chain (bilateral filter, CLAHE, unsharp mask, gamma and a final linear contrast/brightness step), not the face region of the original
measures.reading: associations between image statistics, class, session and delivered scores; the aggregate class AUROC and the within-class Spearman confound subject and class, the within-subject AUROC holds the subject fixed; they indicate associations, not causes

images.layout: <bonafide|attack>_<training|validation>/<name>; every file accepted only with SHA-256 and bytes equal to the manifest row

cache.order: X_train = spread per class of the official training list (bona fide first) = cnn_train + cnn_es; X_test = spread of the official test list = cnn_test (M2 rule, N2 check)
cache.built: 2026-09-12 with the extractor face.py 0ac7143 (reproduced bit for bit in N2)
